purpose: Replay D016 (dashboard approval, then automerge) against the retained consumer inputs, and determine why runner branch results lack groupName.

runtime.execution: Direct calls to installed Renovate extraction, preset resolution, lookupUpdates, package-rule application, and branchifyUpgrades APIs; platform=local, dryRun=lookup. No platform branch/PR/dashboard mutation API invoked.
runtime.preset_resolution: Repository preset bodies supplied from exact local before/after bytes in Renovate memory cache; built-in presets resolved by Renovate. This changes no consumer file or external preset.

replay_recipe: Copy the baseline receipt into a temporary root at its original relative path. Replace its preset_inputs[presets/github-actions-security.json] content and sha256 with candidate_preset. Write baseline harness_source to verify.mjs and apply harness_diff. Execute with Renovate 44.145.1 and Node 24.11.1, passing the temporary root and Renovate package root. No platform mutation API is invoked.

approval_dispositions.kind: Real runner lookup branch with an explicit missing-branch/no-dashboard-check platform fixture
approval_dispositions.automergeResult: not exercised: requires platform branch status

group_name_finding.observation: Package-rule results carry groupName GitHub-Hosted Runners; single-update runner branches carry no groupName.
group_name_finding.cause: Renovate generateBranchConfig deletes groupName when a group branch holds one update and groupSingleUpdates is not true. The branch keeps the group slug. Receipt generation projects groupName whenever present and drops nothing.

limits: Approval disposition (needs-approval) and automerge=true on runner branches are exercised. tryBranchAutomerge is not exercised because it needs platform branch status; hosted automerge after approval remains unobserved. Consumers without required checks merge on approval. No consumer edit or publication is implied.
status: All retained harness assertions pass with automerge=true; runner package-rule results assert groupName GitHub-Hosted Runners.
